gaps.sentence: Rising sea levels ___ (THREAT) the very existence of the island.
gaps.explanation: A main verb is needed after the plural subject: threaten.

gaps.sentence: The instructions were ___ (WRITE) in six languages.
gaps.explanation: Passive voice: were written — irregular participle of write.
The journey causes tiredness: tiring. 'Tiresome' means annoying.
'Appealed for calm' — the set phrase uses 'calm' as noun.

gaps.sentence: He has a wide ___ (KNOW) of local history.
His ___ (REFUSE) to cooperate stalled the negotiations.
The economy showed further ___ (WEAK) in the third quarter.
gaps.explanation: 'Further weakness' — the noun form follows the adjective 'further'.
